agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 28, 2021 -
05:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the March 17, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-04-28 SDWD Item S08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Fadhil
Approve the Warrants List.
2021-04-28 SDWD Item S08B Warrants
8C.
Mutual Aid Agreement providing for emergency assistance among the San Diego County Water Authority and Its Member Agencies. Contact Person: Interim Operations Manager Gonzalez
1) Authorize the General Manager to execute an Agreement with the San Diego County Water Authority (SDCWA) and its member agencies to provide and receive emergency assistance when needed due to any emergency, or extraordinary or unusual circumstance; and 2) Authorize the General Manager, at his or her discretion, to assist or request such assistance in the event of an emergency that would prevent the SDWD or SDCWA or its member agencies from providing services to its population and or safeguarding its water system.
2021-04-28 SDWD Item S08C Mutual Aid Agreement
8D.
Notice of Completion for City of Encinitas Tentative Map No. 14-069, 764 and 782 Leucadia Boulevard Public Water Improvements. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the Interim General Manager to file a Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-04-28 SDWD Item S08D NOC for 764 & 782 Leucadia Blvd Shea Homes
8E.
Notice of Completion for City of Encinitas Tentative Map No. 89-014, 2100 North Coast Highway 101 Public Water Improvements.
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the Interim General Manager to file a Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-04-28 SDWD Item S08E NOC for Encinitas Beach Hotel
8F.
Acceptance of $10,000 from the ACWA-JPIA Risk Control Program Grant to purchase a MetroTech Water Leak Correlator and implement a leak detection program. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-09 accepting a $10,000 ACWA-JPIA Risk Control Program Grant; and 2) Authorize the City Manager for the purchase of Metro Tech Water Leak Correlator equipment.
2021-04-28 SDWD Item S08F Acceptance of JPIA Risk Control Grant
8G.
Quitclaim of Water Easements to Matthew S. Adams and Nicole R. Adams, Trustees of the Matthew S. and Nicole R. Adams Living Trust, dated April 16, 2003 located at 1356 Crest Drive, Encinitas (APN 262-011-10-00). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
1) Adopt Resolution No 2021-08, entitled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Approving Quitclaim of Water Easement on 1356 Crest Drive, Encinitas (APN 262-011-10-00)(Attachment 2 of the agenda report); and 2) Authorize the Interim General Manager to file a Quitclaim Deed of Public Water Easement (Attachment 3 of the agenda report).
2021-04-28 SDWD Item S08G Quitclaim 1356 Crest Drive
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board.
10A.
Update on the Status of San Dieguito Water District’s 2020 Urban Water Management Plan. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
Receive the report regarding San Dieguito Water District’s 2020 Urban Water Management Plan, review and discuss the information as presented, and advise staff of changes, if any, desired by the board.
2021-04-28 SDWD Item S10A UWMP Update
2021-04-28 SDWD Item S10A UWMP Update - Presentation
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Water Supply Update. Contact Person: Interim General Manager Hireish
Receive the oral presentation.
2021-04-28 SDWD Item S11A Water Supply Update
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MAY 19, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
